ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio (~65:35 white-to-black pixel ratio) on the visible ventral surface, characterized by high-intensity white interior lobes and low-intensity black perimeter borders.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones occupying the central 70% of each lobe. These zones are punctuated by localized low-intensity black pixel clusters (mottling), with a dense concentration of irregular black spots on the distal portion of the right lobe and scattered individual spots on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible acute V-shaped central depression with a deep vertical bounding-box depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration map along the trailing edge, featuring high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (jagged peaks) from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve at the leading edge towards the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular black clusters detected on the white fields of both lobes, particularly a dense grouping on the upper-inner margin of the right lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric mottling pattern where the right lobe distal tip contains significantly higher black pixel density compared to the left lobe distal tip.
